marketing_description: The DeWALT DCB2108-2 is a 2-pack bundle of 20 V MAX XR Series batteries, each with a 8 Ah capacity and Lithium-Ion chemistry. Compatible with DeWALT 20 V MAX tools, these batteries feature XR premium technology for reliable performance. They are part of the MAX XR Series, a range of batteries designed for use with 20V MAX system tools.
